variables.name: action_creates_case
variables.description: The candidate tool call creates a new customer_case record.

variables.name: action_case_state_new
variables.description: The candidate case-creation call sets state to 'new' (or omits state where the system default 'new' applies).

variables.name: action_case_priority_moderate_when_unspecified
variables.description: True if the requester specified a priority and the call uses that priority, or the requester specified none and the call uses 'moderate'.

variables.name: context_contact_account_verified
variables.description: A prior successful read in this trajectory returned the reporting contact record and showed its association to the account used in the candidate case.

variables.name: context_case_product_belongs_to_account
variables.description: A prior successful read showed the product or installed product named in the candidate call belongs to the reporting customer's account.

variables.name: action_assigns_case_to_user
variables.description: The candidate call sets assigned_to on a customer_case (case assignment to a user).

variables.name: action_assignment_includes_group
variables.description: The candidate case-assignment call also specifies an assignment_group_id.

variables.name: context_assignee_role_agent_or_manager
variables.description: A prior successful user read showed the user referenced by assigned_to has role 'agent' or 'manager'.

variables.name: context_assignee_active
variables.description: A prior successful user read showed the user referenced by assigned_to is active.

variables.name: context_assignee_member_of_group
variables.description: A prior successful read or successful membership-add showed the assigned_to user is a member of the assignment_group_id used in the candidate call.

variables.name: action_sets_case_state_closed
variables.description: The candidate call sets a customer_case state to 'closed'.

variables.name: context_case_state_resolved
variables.description: A prior successful read or successful update showed the target case is currently in state 'resolved'.

variables.name: action_sets_closed_on
variables.description: The candidate closure call supplies a closed_on timestamp argument.

variables.name: action_invalid_state_transition
variables.description: The candidate call changes a case state from a known current state to a target state not permitted by the listed transitions (new→in_progress/pending/resolved; in_progress→pending/resolved; pending→in_progress/resolved; resolved→closed; canceled).

variables.name: action_updates_case
variables.description: The candidate call modifies an existing customer_case record (any field).

variables.name: context_actor_owns_or_assigned_case
variables.description: Evidence in the request or prior successful reads shows the acting user owns the target case, is assigned to it, or belongs to its assignment group.

variables.name: action_modifies_user_group_membership
variables.description: The candidate call creates, updates or deactivates user, user_group, or group-membership records.

variables.name: context_actor_role_admin
variables.description: Evidence in the request or prior successful reads establishes the acting user's own role is 'admin' (the assistant's declared administrator role counts); target-record roles do not.

variables.name: action_sets_escalation_true
variables.description: The candidate call sets escalation = true on a case.

variables.name: action_sets_escalation_reason
variables.description: The same candidate call supplies a non-empty escalation_reason argument.

variables.name: action_links_knowledge_to_case
variables.description: The candidate call creates a case_knowledge link between a knowledge article and a case.

variables.name: context_knowledge_article_published
variables.description: A prior successful read showed the linked knowledge article's state is 'published'.

variables.name: action_attaches_installed_product_to_case
variables.description: The candidate call sets or attaches an installed_product on a customer_case.

variables.name: context_installed_product_active_in_use
variables.description: A prior successful read showed that installed product's status is 'in_use' (not repair/retired/in_stock).

variables.name: context_installed_product_belongs_to_account
variables.description: A prior successful read showed that installed product belongs to the reporting account of the case.

variables.name: action_enum_value_outside_allowed_list
variables.description: Any candidate argument for an enumerated field (user.role, user_group.type, location.city/country, account.account_type, product.category/lifecycle_state, installed_product.status, contract fields, entitlement fields, sla_definition fields, customer_case.channel/priority/state/escalation_reason, interaction.channel, knowledge.state/visibility, case_knowledge.used_as) has a value outside the policy's allowed list.

variables.name: action_free_text_length_out_of_range
variables.description: A free-form text argument in the candidate call (case short_description, knowledge title, knowledge content/body, escalation_reason text) has fewer than 30 or more than 120 characters.

variables.name: action_creates_location
variables.description: The candidate call creates a location record.

variables.name: action_location_name_supplied_by_user
variables.description: The requester explicitly supplied the location name used in the candidate location-creation call.

variables.name: action_location_name_default_format
variables.description: The location name argument follows the default 'User <id> - <City>' format.

rules.title: Verify contact and account before creating a case
rules.rationale: Cases must be registered against a verified contact associated with an account.
rules.reference: Core Operations 1. Registering a Customer Case
rules.quote: Begin by identifying the reporting **contact** and verifying association with an **account**.
rules.remediation: Look up the contact and confirm its account association before creating the case.

rules.title: Product must belong to the customer's account
rules.rationale: Prevents cases against products the account does not own.
rules.reference: Core Operations 1. Registering a Customer Case
rules.quote: Verify the product or installed product belongs to the customer’s account.
rules.remediation: Verify product/installed-product ownership for the account before creating the case.

rules.title: Apply default state and priority on case creation
rules.rationale: New cases default to state new and priority moderate when unspecified.
rules.reference: Core Operations 1. Registering a Customer Case
rules.quote:
* Priority (if not provided → default = **moderate**)

* Default state = **new**.
rules.remediation: Create the case with state 'new' and priority 'moderate' when no priority was given.

rules.title: Assignee must be an active agent/manager in the group
rules.rationale: Assignment constraints restrict who may receive a case.
rules.quote: `assigned_to` must reference a `user` with role `agent` or `manager` and (if used) member of `assignment_group_id`.
rules.remediation: Confirm the user is active, has role agent or manager, and is a member of the assignment group (add membership first) before assigning.

rules.title: Close only from resolved, with closed_on
rules.rationale: Premature closure without resolution is forbidden and closure timestamps must be captured.
rules.quote: Cases cannot be closed directly. They must first be moved to **resolved**, then to **closed**.
rules.remediation: Move the case to 'resolved' first, then close it supplying closed_on.

rules.title: Forbid illegal state transitions
rules.rationale: Only the listed lifecycle transitions are valid.
rules.remediation: Use only the permitted transitions for the case's current state.

rules.title: Update only cases the actor owns, is assigned to, or whose group they are in
rules.quote: Users may only view or update cases they own, are assigned to, or are in the assigned group.
rules.remediation: Only update cases within the acting user's ownership, assignment, or assigned group.

rules.title: Only admins may modify user/group/membership data
rules.rationale: Agents cannot modify user, group, or membership data; administrators have full access.
rules.quote: Cannot modify **user, group, or membership data**.
rules.remediation: Only act on user, group or membership records when acting in the administrator role.

rules.title: Escalation requires an escalation_reason
rules.rationale: Escalation is tracked on the case with a captured reason.
rules.remediation: Supply a valid escalation_reason in the same update that sets escalation = true.

rules.title: Link only published knowledge articles
rules.rationale: Only published articles may be linked to cases.
rules.remediation: Verify the article state is 'published' before linking it to a case.

rules.title: Installed product must be in_use and owned by the account
rules.rationale: Retired/repair items must not be attached and items must belong to the reporting account.
rules.quote: Do not attach items in **retired / repair** status to new cases.
rules.remediation: Verify the installed product is in_use and belongs to the reporting account before attaching it.

rules.title: Reject values outside the predefined lists
rules.rationale: Enumerated fields accept only listed values.
rules.quote: reject any value outside the list with `INVALID_ENUM_VALUE`
rules.remediation: Use only values from the policy's predefined lists for enumerated fields.

rules.title: Free-form text must be 30-120 characters
rules.rationale: Policy sets character limits for free-form text fields.
rules.remediation: Rewrite the text so it contains between 30 and 120 characters.

rules.title: Use default location name format when none is given
rules.rationale: Default naming convention applies when the user does not provide a location name.
rules.quote: Only if the location name is not given by user for location creation.
rules.remediation: When no name is supplied, name the location using the 'User <id> - <City>' format.

reviewer_format.instructions: Review the proposed tool call against the CSM Assistant Policy. Check: required case-creation inputs and defaults (state new, priority moderate when unspecified), contact/account verification, product-account ownership, assignment constraints (active agent/manager, group membership), lifecycle transitions and resolved-before-closed with closed_on, update scope (owner/assignee/group), admin-only user/group/membership changes, published-only knowledge links, installed-product status and ownership, enum values, and 30-120 character free-text limits. Reads must never be blocked. Report each violated obligation as a short issue string citing the policy section.

approved.description: true if the call complies with the policy

extractor_format.instructions: From the user request, policy defaults, prior successful tool calls/results, and the candidate call's arguments only, set each fact true or false; use null when evidence is absent. action_* facts describe the candidate call's arguments and the state change it requests. context_* facts require an earlier successful observation about the same actor, case, user, article, product or account; results about a different resource do not count. Requester-supplied IDs or role claims do not establish existence, membership, role, activity or ownership. Candidate results, hidden databases and future steps are unavailable. Give a brief evidence string per fact naming the call or statement relied upon, or 'no evidence'.
